packageManagers.title: Package Managers
packageManagers.description: This is the configuration details for the registry. Each package manager could have different configuration, expand each section for more details. If the section is disable review your configuration.
packageManagers.yarnclassicDetails: Yarn classic configuration differs from Yarn 2+ configuration. For more details, please visit [Yarn Classic](https://verdaccio.org/docs/cli-registry#yarn-1x).
packageManagers.yarnBerryDetails: Yarn Berry does not support the `--registry` flag, instead all configurarion should be defined on the `yarnrc.yaml` file in the root of your project. For more details, please visit [Yarn Berry](https://verdaccio.org/docs/cli-registry#yarn-berry-2x).

minReleaseAge.title: Minimum release age
minReleaseAge.description: Skip versions published in the last {{days}} days, so a malicious release has time to be reported and removed before anyone installs it. Where the client allows it, packages of {{scope}}, published here, stay exempt so your own releases install right away.
minReleaseAge.npm: npm 11.10 or newer; the scope exemption needs npm 12.
minReleaseAge.yarn: Each scope can have its own gate under npmScopes (yarn 4.17 or newer); 0 turns it off for the scope.
minReleaseAge.bun: minimumReleaseAge is in seconds. bun exempts exact package names only, so list the packages of the scope in minimumReleaseAgeExcludes.
minReleaseAge.registry: Registry operators can enforce a minimum age for everybody with the [package filter](https://verdaccio.org/docs/configuration#package-filter) (`minAgeDays`).

packageManagers.bunDetails: bun reads the registry from `bunfig.toml` (or `.npmrc`) and the token that `npm adduser` saves in `.npmrc`. For more details, please visit [bun](https://verdaccio.org/docs/setup-bun).
